tools.name: hetzner_list_servers
tools.description: List the servers in the token's project, optionally filtered by name, status or a label selector. Hetzner Cloud: GET /servers.

tools.name: hetzner_get_server
tools.description: Fetch a single server with its type, image, IPs, volumes, networks and protection flags. Hetzner Cloud: GET /servers/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_get_server_metrics
tools.description: Fetch CPU, disk or network time series for one server over a window. Hetzner Cloud: GET /servers/{id}/metrics.

tools.name: hetzner_list_server_types
tools.description: List the available server types with their cores, memory, disk and hourly and monthly prices — read this before creating a server. Hetzner Cloud: GET /server_types.

tools.name: hetzner_list_images
tools.description: List OS images, snapshots and backups you can boot or restore from. Hetzner Cloud: GET /images.

tools.name: hetzner_list_locations
tools.description: List the datacentre locations (city, country, network zone) servers can run in. Hetzner Cloud: GET /locations.

tools.name: hetzner_get_pricing
tools.description: Fetch the full price list for the project's currency — server types, volumes, traffic, floating IPs, load balancers and backups. Hetzner Cloud: GET /pricing.

tools.name: hetzner_get_action
tools.description: Fetch the status of one asynchronous action. Every write tool here returns an action id — poll it with this to see whether the operation finished. Hetzner Cloud: GET /actions/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_volumes
tools.description: List block-storage volumes, their size and which server they are attached to. Hetzner Cloud: GET /volumes.

tools.name: hetzner_get_volumes
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /volumes/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_networks
tools.description: List private networks, their IP ranges, subnets and routes. Hetzner Cloud: GET /networks.

tools.name: hetzner_get_networks
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /networks/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_firewalls
tools.description: List firewalls, their rules and which resources they are applied to. Hetzner Cloud: GET /firewalls.

tools.name: hetzner_get_firewalls
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /firewalls/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_load_balancers
tools.description: List load balancers, their services, targets and health status. Hetzner Cloud: GET /load_balancers.

tools.name: hetzner_get_load_balancers
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /load_balancers/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_ssh_keys
tools.description: List the SSH public keys available to inject when creating a server. Hetzner Cloud: GET /ssh_keys.

tools.name: hetzner_get_ssh_keys
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /ssh_keys/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_floating_ips
tools.description: List floating IPs and which server each is assigned to. Hetzner Cloud: GET /floating_ips.

tools.name: hetzner_get_floating_ips
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /floating_ips/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_primary_ips
tools.description: List primary IPs and their assignments. Hetzner Cloud: GET /primary_ips.

tools.name: hetzner_get_primary_ips
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /primary_ips/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_certificates
tools.description: List TLS certificates, managed or uploaded, and their expiry. Hetzner Cloud: GET /certificates.

tools.name: hetzner_get_certificates
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /certificates/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_create_server
tools.description: Provision a new server. THIS STARTS BILLING: the chosen server type is charged by the hour from the moment it boots. Call hetzner_list_server_types first to see prices, and hetzner_list_images for a bootable image. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers.

tools.name: hetzner_poweron_server
tools.description: Power on a stopped server. Returns an action id — poll it with hetzner_get_action. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/poweron.

tools.name: hetzner_shutdown_server
tools.description: Ask the guest OS to shut down gracefully via ACPI. Prefer this over a hard power-off. Note that a stopped server still costs money — only deleting it stops the bill. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/shutdown.

tools.name: hetzner_reboot_server
tools.description: Reboot a server gracefully via ACPI. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/reboot.

tools.name: hetzner_create_image_from_server
tools.description: Create a snapshot image from a server's disk — the safe thing to do BEFORE a risky change. Snapshots are billed for the space they use. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/create_image.

tools.name: hetzner_enable_server_backup
tools.description: Turn on automatic backups for a server. This adds roughly 20% to the server's price. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/enable_backup.

tools.name: hetzner_disable_server_backup
tools.description: Turn off automatic backups for a server. Existing backups are DELETED. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/disable_backup.

tools.name: hetzner_change_server_protection
tools.description: Turn deletion and rebuild protection on or off for a server. Turning protection ON is the safest write in this server. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/change_protection.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "hetzner_list_ssh_keys" references sensitive artifacts (ssh_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
